name: Forah
source:
The title of a Countessa marks her as a member of nobility, though it is unknown from which sovereignty she hails from. Forah is not a human and takes great offence when you suggest as much, but beyond having "peculiar" eyes, she does not appear any different.

While she can be very bold and rash in social situations, especially when pursuing something she wants, during which she can be very selfish and outright ruthless, she is quick to shy from situations that could potentially hurt her.

She is trying to find her place in life and is attracted to things that seem to have answers she does not, probably explaining her intent interest in the Cuthintal.

She is very wealthy and, as far as the exploitation of other people is involved, not all that concerned with any sort of morality consideration, even going as far as directly owning slaves.(from official website)
